pre-cached

span.p:
Retry Layer
(Component)
Simplified prompt on 429 +
Exponential backoff 1s/2s/4s +
Max 3 retry

span.p:
Fallback Layer
(Component)
Fallback V4-Pro to V4-Flash
(NOT vice versa)
on V4-Pro 500 / timeout

60s cooldown +
fallback canned/static
during open state
